candidates.reason: This module imports scrapy.utils.log.logformatter_adapter and is the only place that unit-tests it directly. That adapter is where a LogFormatterResult dict is turned into logging.log arguments, including the dict-args branch that the pull request deprecates. TestLogformatterAdapter.test_empty_args and TestLogformatterAdapter.test_args parametrize None/{}/() and dict-vs-tuple args and assert the rendered message, so the deprecation warning and any change to how returned dicts are interpolated must be reflected here.

This module covers scrapy.logformatter.LogFormatter, whose methods return the {'level','msg','args'} dicts that the pull request sends through the deprecated interpolation path. TestLogFormatter and TestLogformatterSubclass assert dict-arg message templates such as CRAWLEDMSG/SCRAPEDMSG/DROPPEDMSG via msg % args, and TestShowOrSkipMessages runs a real crawl and asserts the final rendered log text (Crawled/Scraped/Dropped), so it exercises dict-argument log messages end to end.
